title: A2 workbench shell (desktop surface)
description: Rewrite the prototype properly as the desktop main surface: split navigator (connection list over scoped schema tree), filter box, tables expand to columns, tab-to-navigator sync, save-query dialog as form (Enter saves, autofocus). Fold src/features/_prototype/workbench then delete prototype files + route. See NOTES.md.

title: Per-tab connection binding in workspaceStore
description: Tabs carry connectionId; query routing per tab through the transport; per-tab cancel; remove single-client assumption (lines ~219-310 region). Explorer follows the focused tab.

title: Engine-discriminated SavedConnection + engine-aware ConnectionForm
description: Add engine field (discriminated union) to SavedConnection; IndexedDB migration defaults existing rows to clickhouse. ConnectionForm renders per engine: server engines (host/port/user/pass/db), file engines (path + native file picker via IPC, DuckDB :memory: hint).

title: Secrets via safeStorage with fallback chain
description: Electron: passwords stored main-side via safeStorage (keychain), fallback encrypted file, last-resort localStorage with warning. Renderer keeps secretRef only. Update connection export/import: prompt export with/without passwords; export pulls secrets from main.

title: Main-process connection pool + lifecycle
description: Pool keyed by connectionId (shared across tabs of same connection). Lazy-open on first query/expand, idle-timeout close (~5min), explicit disconnect IPC, status events to renderer (connected/idle/disconnected dots).

title: AdapterTransport seam: in-process (web) + IPC (Electron)
description: Single transport abstraction the renderer calls. Web build: direct in-process call to the CH adapter. Electron: contextBridge/IPC to main. Includes cancel-by-id (replace AbortController passing), serializable result envelope, error mapping.

title: DbAdapter interface + dialect descriptor + capabilities
description: Define DbAdapter (connect/query/listSchemas/listTables/describeTable), DialectDescriptor (CodeMirror dialect + param syntax/extraction), capabilities flags (admin descriptor, etc). Port the ClickHouse logic in workspaceStore into a ClickHouseAdapter so the UI no longer imports @clickhouse/client directly. CH-specific extractQueryParams moves into the CH dialect descriptor.
close_reason: Implemented DbAdapter interface, DialectDescriptor, AdapterCapabilities, and ClickHouseAdapter. Wired workspaceStore through the adapter. All types clean, build passing, no regressions.

title: Electron scaffold: electron-vite + electron-builder
description: Add electron/main + electron/preload, electron.vite.config.ts reusing src/ as renderer. Scripts: dev:desktop, build:desktop, dist:desktop (Linux AppImage). vite.config.ts and Dockerfile must remain byte-identical. Verify: desktop window opens rendering the existing app.

title: Phase 1: Multi-DB desktop workbench (Electron)
description: Turn ch-ui into a multi-database desktop workbench (ClickHouse, Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB) via Electron, while the web build stays CH-only and untouched for the team Docker deployment. Full decision record in src/features/_prototype/workbench/NOTES.md and this epic's children.

title: Fix autocomplete: missing functions + slow performance
description: Functions like today()/yesterday() only shown in SELECT clause. Need to show in all expression contexts. Also add interactionDelay to debounce rapid keystrokes.
close_reason: Functions now suggested in all expression contexts (SELECT, WHERE, HAVING, PREWHERE, GROUP_BY, ORDER_BY, and default). Added 75ms interactionDelay to debounce rapid keystrokes.

title: Migrate metricsConfig to clickhouse dashboard template
description: Move all metrics from metricsConfig.ts to clickhouse.ts dashboard template, making Metrics.tsx redundant

title: Add query interpolation to analytics dashboard
description: Port the metrics query interpolation system to analytics so rawsql configs can use template variables like $__timeFromTo, $__timeBucket

title: CodeMirror dialect + param handling per active tab
description: Editor reads DialectDescriptor from the focused tab's adapter: CodeMirror SQL dialect, autocomplete schema source, param extraction strategy. CH {x:String}, PG $1, MySQL/SQLite ?.

title: DuckDB adapter (@duckdb/node-api)
description: Native module (electron-rebuild). Introspection via duckdb catalog. File-based config incl. :memory:. CodeMirror SQL fallback dialect.

title: SQLite adapter (better-sqlite3)
description: Native module (electron-rebuild). Introspection via sqlite_master/PRAGMA. Dialect: ? params, CodeMirror SQLite dialect. File-based connection config.

title: MySQL adapter (mysql2)
description: Driver mysql2 in main. Introspection via information_schema. Dialect: ? params, CodeMirror MySQL dialect. Capabilities: no admin in Phase 1.

title: Postgres adapter (pg)
description: Driver pg in main. Introspection via information_schema/pg_catalog. Dialect: $1 params, CodeMirror PostgreSQL dialect. Capabilities: no admin in Phase 1.

title: Add default dashboard templates from HyperDX
description: Implement preset dashboard links in DashboardListPage and importable chart templates for any dashboard. Based on HyperDX patterns: nodejs-runtime, go-runtime, jvm-runtime, dotnet-runtime.
close_reason: Implemented preset dashboards and importable templates

title: Decide fate of observability features (traces/sessions/services/logs/alerts)
description: These HyperDX-style features are CH-coupled and stay web-only (Phase 1 decision Q13b). User signaled they might be slated for removal entirely. Decide: keep web-only, gate behind capabilities, or remove.

title: Unify web workspace onto A2 shell
description: After the A2 shell proves itself on desktop, migrate the web build's workspace page to it (single-connection CH-only degradation). Team gets Enter-to-save fix etc. Deliberate version bump the team opts into. Decision Q14(ii).

title: Phase 2: refactor admin suite onto capabilities.admin descriptor
description: Drive the ~17k-line CH admin/permissions UI off capabilities.admin = {users, roles, grants, rowPolicies, quotas, settingsProfiles} instead of direct CH DDL. CH unchanged behavior proves the abstraction. Blocks PG/MySQL admin.

title: Desktop distribution beyond local Linux builds
description: v1 = Linux AppImage built locally, unsigned, no auto-update (decision Q10). If other users/platforms appear: GitHub Releases, electron-updater, macOS signing/notarization, Windows signing.

title: Redis support (deferred)
description: Redis is a command engine, not SQL: no query(sql), no tables/columns. Needs a parallel interaction model (command console, key browser, per-type value views). Deliberately out of Phase 1 scope so it does not distort the DbAdapter design. Decision Q3.

title: Phase 4: MySQL admin (users/roles/grants/resource limits)
description: MySQL access model: user@host identities, roles (8.0+), GRANT semantics, per-user resource limits (MAX_QUERIES_PER_HOUR etc).

title: Phase 3: Postgres admin (users/roles/grants/RLS)
description: PG access model: roles-are-users (LOGIN attr), pg_roles, GRANT on schemas/tables/columns, Row-Level Security via CREATE POLICY. New engine-specific panels per capabilities descriptor.
